en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham and Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, from the one who mentioned, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding
the man who married the temporary marriage, would he be (classified as) married?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. But rather that (being married) is upon the thing which is always with him’.
